description: Land Acquisition - Melegama, Mestiya and Mawala Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, assessment numbers, descriptions (garden, paddy field, etc.), claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
